summary.text: Joe Krzeczkowski, an unaffiliated candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Colorado's 7th Congressional District to Brittany Pettersen.
He describes himself as a technology executive and software professional who has led global engineering teams.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Krzeczkowski was raised on a small family farm outside Ann Arbor, Michigan, and moved to Colorado in 2012. He graduated from Saline High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan in 2011.

His campaign website says his father was a Ford autoworker, that he is one of six children, and that he lost two siblings to muscular dystrophy. It says he earned a full-ride scholarship to the University of Michigan Engineering School.
Krzeczkowski's career experience is listed as engineer. His campaign website says he has spent his career in Colorado leading global software teams and running small businesses.
The site says he most recently led a Community Council in Lakewood, supported the Make Lakewood Livable campaign, and lives in Lakewood with his partner.
During the campaign, he said he was running to reform campaign finance, protect constitutional freedoms, and address housing, education, and infrastructure.
He received 1.2% of the vote to Brittany Pettersen's 60.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
